annotation.title_clean: Safe Execution of RL Policies via Acceleration-based CBF-QP Constraint Enforcement for Real-World Robotic Deployments
annotation.title_en: Safe Execution of RL Policies via Acceleration-based CBF-QP Constraint Enforcement for Real-World Robotic Deployments
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Muraccioli, B.; Cariou, A.; Leziart, P.; Celerier, M.; Demont, A.; Venture, G.; et al.
annotation.summary_en: Technical robotics paper proposing Acc-CBF-QP, a runtime safety filter using control barrier functions that constrains reinforcement-learning policies to joint, torque, velocity and collision limits. Validated on a Kinova Gen3 arm and Unitree H1 humanoid, cutting constraint violations by 92% on hardware without retraining. Contains no governance or regulatory content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Acc-CBF-QP filters any RL policy at runtime without retraining
Enforces joint position, velocity, torque and self-collision constraints
TorqueTask and Forward Dynamics Task regulate safety-performance trade-offs
Real H1 violations reduced from 10.04/s to 0.80/s; Kinova violations eliminated
